title: SB2961 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 38, Chapter 6 and Section 39-17-1316, relative to the transfer of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-14; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514151508 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2961.pdf (LegiScan doc 2927771))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-02-14); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing. Existing (c) is redesignated (c)(1); the House twin is HB 1596 (same document). Effective date in text is July 1, 2023.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1316(c)): (2) Except with respect to transactions between persons licensed as dealers under 18 U.S.C. § 923, a gun dealer shall not deliver a firearm to a purchaser until fifteen (15) business days after compliance with subdivision (c)(1).
